summary: Lando Norris starts Sunday's finale from pole position but braces for a fierce challenge from Mercedes and Ferrari after George Russell dominated the sprint race at Zandvoort. Russell's commanding sprint victory signals Mercedes' resurgence in the fight for track position, setting up a critical battle for the opening lap that could determine the outcome. A win for Norris would cement his championship credentials in the season's final race, while a Russell or Ferrari triumph would dramatically reshape the title narrative heading into the off-season.
